title: Crystal Casing
text: A transparent building block with a Spiritual Crystal frame and glass interior. Adjacent casings connect their trim.

Right-click a Create shaft, either cogwheel size or fluid pipe with the casing to add a transparent shell without consuming it. Wrench the axial end faces to toggle shaft connections; sneak-wrench to remove kinetic shells. Encased pipes preserve their connections and pump-driven flow; ordinary wrenching removes their shell.
